name: Arduino Nano ESP32 (ESP32-S3, u-blox NORA-W106)
radio: the SoC's own radios: wifi24, ble

flash.bootloader_instructions: Double-tap the B1 button for Arduino's DFU bootloader, or hold B1 while pressing RST for the chip's ROM download mode (USB-JTAG-serial), which is what the page's flasher needs.
flash.note: Values from public documentation; not yet verified on a board of this kind (the target is experimental until then).

usb.when: Arduino's own bootloader (DFU) — not what esptool talks to
ESP32-S3/C5 USB-JTAG-serial (download mode and, with CDC on boot, the running firmware)

led.note: three analog-driven LED lines (kitsune writes 255 - value, scaled to 75)

battery.divider_note: Powered from USB or a 5 V pack. kitsune's note: the pack must not have a low-current cut-off, or the board never wakes from deep sleep.

notes: Ships with Arduino's DFU bootloader; esptool flashing replaces the whole flash, which is how kitsune's PlatformIO builds are loaded. kitsune notes client mode gets the wrong MAC on this board.

serial.notes: kitsune prints 'ESP32 boot count', 'Awake and screaming', 'Going to sleep' and 'PANIC' on its serial port; no command interface.
